children: Laird Superfood named Mark Johnson as its next chief financial officer, effective in October.
Johnson will be the principal financial officer and principal accounting officer, and report to Chief Executive Jason Vieth, the company said Friday.
He most recently was vice president of finance, North America, for Tropicana Brands Group.
